scope: Prospective developer-controlled operational comparison and real scripted GUI conformance on two previously used public datasets. Not held-out, human authoring productivity, independent researcher judgment, blinded visual ratings, or a claim that either arm must win.
prerequisite: This protocol must be publicly committed/CI accepted. Both producers, controllers and the evaluator must then be implemented, untimed parity-checked and separately Git/CI sealed before formal timing. No formal timing is permitted by protocol preparation alone. Finish candidate UI fixes before the implementation seal. Record all exact code/resource/env hashes.
views: Sex-complete penguins is an explicit333-row subset; singleton control takes one real row per species/sex. Iris mm explicitly multiplies each four cm measurements by10 with Decimal; no new observations. Original UCI files, including their documented differences, remain unchanged. SD describes observed spread, not population confidence or causal inference.

baseline_contract.numerics: Separately authored csv/statistics or equivalent direct numerical calculations; no GraphUnslopify-generated drawing/statistics/claims code. Match frozen independent Decimal ground truth and actual artists, counts, group/order/units/SD ddof1. The earlier papers reference is a starting reference, not the complete benchmark baseline.
baseline_contract.strength: Use normal Matplotlib artist/layout APIs, typed reusable functions, warmed processes, safe content-keyed calculation caches and safe incremental paper updates. Never handicap the baseline by requiring unnecessary rerender/recomputation. Shared inspect_figure is allowed as the same legibility gate, explicitly disclosed; scientific calculations/claims remain independently implemented.
baseline_contract.artifacts: Match requested PNG/SVG/PDF or declared PNG-only outputs, physical width/DPI, required literal labels/units/legend, usable readable layout, numerical/claim report and data/program/environment manifests. Keep immutable source-bound history, failed evidence, current-output integrity and honest reuse ancestry in both arms.
baseline_contract.paper_reuse: Both may reuse intact accepted unchanged figures with complete data/intent/policy/producer/environment keys. Never reuse acceptance after a failed latest whole-paper run or membership change. Inspect current evidence; retain original sources for reused reports. Recheck claims/geometry/exports for every executed figure; never cache acceptance as a calculation.

gates.data_and_code_hashes: Actual bytes, not normalized expected strings.
gates.quality: Same scientific, physical/export, required-text and legibility checks. Warnings remain reported. Review PNG144 is not called a publication600 output. Do not infer task correctness from the product's status alone; independent task/artist/unit/label gates also apply.

actor_setup: One familiarized scripted operational actor; same frozen requests/artifacts. All producer/operator code prepared before formal clocks; its authoring cost is unmeasured and excluded for both arms. No human productivity claim. Record dependency/install and fixture preparation separately; no hidden arm-specific setup. No model/provider is configured for quality evaluation; no mock output counts as a real model result.

clocks.clock: Same-host perf_counter_ns wall intervals plus UTC/source/env binding.
clocks.startup: Each fresh arm process from launch through imports/readiness; report separately and include in cold end-to-end. Include owned child startup, handshake and cleanup separately; do not pool with warm requests.
clocks.first_image: Only an actual owned current-request PNG availability event; mark unverified until all task/scientific/export gates finish. Never infer from a timer, earlier image or final report. Record unavailable with reason if genuinely unexposed.
clocks.terminal: Outer request dispatch through final outputs/report and independent task gates. Record first tool acceptance separately from first task-correct strict acceptance; failed/incomplete requests have terminal times and no verified time.
clocks.warm: Same live process/session; all seven ordinary changes retained. Do not exclude a slow first operation as a warmup.
clocks.isolation: No other benchmarks, test suites, artifact downloads, CI/vault work or producer edits during formal timing. Every interruption is retained and invalidates a clean timing interpretation rather than being silently replaced.

single_pipeline.order: In each figure/session run the complete8-request sequence for one arm then the other. Arm order alternates by (figure_index+session_index) parity, fixed figure order as listed. No concurrent arms. Retain24 cold first requests and168 warm operations separately.

paper.shared_data_scope: Both Penguin figures bind the same owned clone of the original344-row CSV. Mass keeps its female/male filter, retaining333 observations. Do not bind its separate GUI sex-complete view for this paper track; CRLF reencoding must affect both Penguin figures.

steps.operation: Select first two figures; review/apply300 DPI, retaining formats and science
Rewrite owned penguin CSV with CRLF, same parsed observations; changed input bytes affect both penguin figures
Change penguin-mass comparison to female above male
Restore supported claim; latest failed run prevents old acceptance reuse
Add fifth figure alias of penguins-mass; membership requires full audit
Remove alias; full four-figure membership audit

paper.order: Alternate arm order by session parity. Review/proposal/save/validation/history costs belong to each arm; do not compare a raw savefig call with a whole-paper audit.

reliability.fault_scope: Eight deliberate faults and four clean controls, all source-preserving clones. Not errors alleged in the papers. Integrity faults test borrowing old acceptance; distinguish unavailable/current-audit-needed from scientific failure. Match the relevant signal, not just any warning. Count all12 cases/two repeats in denominators; missed detections and false alarms remain results.

reproduction.checks: Actual scientific/artist/unit/physical/export/source binding in every relevant environment. Compare decoded PNGs only within the same arm/pinned environment; no cross-renderer or cross-version pixel equality claim. Cross-machine denominator is these four observed CI configurations, not general installations.

gui.actor: Actual browser/manual controls and file drops only, no direct JSON/hidden state or success-response mocking. No first-time-human timing claim. Source/fresh desktop/mobile/keyboard, real strict failures and current exports must remain distinct. Prepared data/typed actions are disclosed. Preserve all failed attempts and report required JSON edits rather than hiding them.

analysis: Retain every raw row. Report attempt/completion/accepted/failed counts, paired per-task medians and IQR, cold startup/first-image/final task-correct time, warm operation and whole-paper update time, actual executions/reuse, all reliability confusion-matrix cells and reproduction denominators. Show slower/failed/partial cases. Do not average incompatible phases or treat missing verified time as zero. No timing threshold, favorable-result stopping or post-outcome task/order/gate tuning.
historical_evidence: Original NIST e310 lineage/v1/v2 protocols, source data and four-episode familiarized-agent study are immutable. Their known earlier results informed this workload; do not replace them, relabel them independent, merge their clocks, or fabricate adoption.
release: No new release/tag authorized. Published0.8.0 remains distinct from the later tested source candidate.
